title: 第9章  李爷爷，你亲吧
slug: 让你当炉做鼎你炼阴阳证大道
content_zh:
许灵溪的话，让李寒山一愣。
把衣服脱光？
瞧见许灵溪那张写满羞涩与怯意的小脸，他顿时明白了过来，许灵溪这是以为他准备以自身为炉鼎，助她修炼呢。
“这孩子，想到哪里去了。”
李寒山哂然失笑，旋即，他意识到另一个问题，自己为什么把许灵溪当成孩子？他的实际年龄，不比她大多少。
想来，还是这百岁躯体惹的祸。
他将这些念头压下，走到床塌上盘腿坐下，指着对面，道：“不需要脱衣服，你在我对面坐下即可。”
“哦。”
许灵溪乖乖听话，脱去布鞋后盘腿坐到了李寒山对面。
“伸手，放松。”
李寒山让她伸出双手，与她双掌相对，便学着梦境里丫头教他的那样，手把手地教起了许灵溪开脉。
许灵溪修炼了一个多月，虽然没有开脉，总归有了一些修炼心得，这让他教起来轻松了许多。
“李爷爷，你懂的还真多。”
许灵溪闭着眼，感受着体内那股暖流的走向，俏脸上浮现出惊讶之色。
李寒山哪里懂什么修炼，不过是照葫芦画瓢罢了。丫头当初怎么教他的，他就怎么教许灵溪。至于能不能成，他心里也没底。
时间一点点过去。
房间里的烛火跳动了三次，窗外的天色从漆黑转为鱼肚白，许灵溪的额头沁出细密的汗珠，小脸涨得通红，身子也微微颤抖起来。
“还是不行......”
许灵溪睁开眼，眼眶红红的，声音里带着哭腔：“李爷爷，我是不是太笨了？”
“不急，再试试。”

李寒山温声安慰，心底却有些犯愁，时间不多了。
接下来的几天，李寒山每天都在教许灵溪开脉。
可无论怎么试，都毫无进展。
第五天夜里，许灵溪终于崩溃了。
她收回双手，眼泪像断了线的珠子一样往下掉，哭得上气不接下气：“李爷爷，我真的不行......我好没用......我不想当炉鼎......可是我真的做不到......”
“别哭。”
李寒山心一软，伸手揉了揉她的脑袋：“我再试试别的办法。”
他沉吟片刻，决定冒险一试。
他将自己的灵力探入许灵溪体内，沿着她的经脉细细感知。丫头教过他，灵力感知是一门基本功，只要足够小心，就不会伤到对方。
灵力在许灵溪体内游走了一圈，李寒山终于发现了问题所在。
许灵溪的经脉并非堵塞，而是有一条极为隐蔽的经脉天生闭合。这条经脉藏得极深，寻常方法根本发现不了，更别提冲开了。
“原来如此。”
李寒山恍然大悟。
怪不得许灵溪修炼了一个多月都没有开脉，问题根本不在于她的资质，而是这条隐脉在作祟。
“灵溪，我找到问题了。”
李寒山睁开眼睛，道：“你体内有一条闭合的隐脉，只要把它冲开，就能开脉成功。”
许灵溪抬起泪眼，将信将疑：“真的吗？”
“信我。”
李寒山深吸一口气，调动灵力朝着那条隐脉冲了过去。他要用灵力将其冲开。
“嗡！”

灵力撞击在闭合的经脉上，发出嗡鸣。许灵溪闷哼一声，脸色煞白，死死咬住嘴唇。
“忍住！”
李寒山没有停下，又连续冲击了三次。
只是，每一次冲击，都像在撕裂许灵溪的经脉，她疼得浑身发抖，眼泪止不住地流，却硬是一声不吭。
“啵！”
伴随着一声轻响，那条闭合的隐脉，豁然贯通！
在这条隐脉被冲开的同时，李寒山抓住机会，一鼓作气，一举帮许灵溪将灵脉冲开！
许灵溪只觉得体内仿佛有什么东西炸开了，一股前所未有的力量从丹田涌出，沿着刚刚打通的经脉奔涌而去。
“开了......真的开了......”
她欢喜的睁开眼，泪水模糊了视线。
然而，还没等她高兴太久，异变陡生！
她的体内突然涌现出一股极其可怕的阴寒之气，如同决堤的洪水般喷薄而出！
这股阴寒之气来得太过猛烈，甚至影响到房间，烛火被吹灭，窗棂上结起了薄薄的冰霜，连空气都凝固了一般。
“这是......”
李寒山瞳孔猛然一缩。
这股阴寒之气，与他体内的纯阳之气形成了强烈的共鸣！他的血液在沸腾，心脏在狂跳，每一个毛孔都在贪婪地吸收着这股气息。
太诱人了。
就像一个饿了三天的乞丐突然看到满汉全席，李寒山的理智在疯狂叫嚣：吸了它！吸了它你的修为能暴涨！
他的手不自觉地向许灵溪伸去。
许灵溪被这突如其来的变故吓懵了，呆呆地看着李寒山，不明白发生了什么。

“不行！”
李寒山咬破舌尖，剧痛让他恢复了一丝清明。
他死死攥住拳头，指甲嵌进肉里，用尽全部意志力压制住那股冲动。
许灵溪信任他，敬重他，把他当成长辈，更别说曾经还救济过他。他若是趁人之危，与合欢宗那些妖女有什么区别？
“呼......”
李寒山闭上眼，强迫自己不去看许灵溪，不去感受那股阴寒之气的诱惑。
但这时，许灵溪的身子开始剧烈颤抖起来。
起初只是手指微微发颤，很快便蔓延到全身。她的嘴唇以肉眼可见的速度变得青紫，眉毛和发丝上结起了一层白霜，整个人像是被扔进了冰窖里。
“李爷爷......我好冷......”
许灵溪牙关打颤，声音断断续续，小脸惨白如纸。她蜷缩着身子，双手抱在胸前，却怎么也止不住那股从骨髓里渗出来的寒意。
李寒山顾不得许多，一把将她揽进怀里。
“没事的，李爷爷在。”
他紧紧抱住许灵溪，试图用自己的体温温暖她。可那股阴寒之气太过霸道，连他的身体都开始结霜，根本暖不了她分毫。
许灵溪的身体越来越冷，呼吸也变得越来越微弱，眼神开始涣散。
李寒山心中一紧，知道再这样下去，许灵溪怕是要被活活冻死。
“灵溪，听我说。”
他捧起许灵溪的脸，沉声道：“你体内这股阴寒之气太多，必须吸出来一些才行。我的纯阳之体可以克制它，但是......”
他顿了顿：“但是我可能得亲你才行。”
许灵溪迷迷糊糊地听到这句话，冻得发紫的嘴唇艰难地动了动：“李爷爷，你吸吧......”
“不是吸，是亲......得用嘴。”

李寒山解释。
除了用嘴，还有一种方法，但那得破了许灵溪的身子了。
许灵溪的意识已经模糊，她只知道冷，冷得快要死了。听到他的话，她几乎是本能地点了点头：“李爷爷，你尽管亲吧......我不怪你......”
说到最后，她的声音已经微不可闻，眼皮沉重地往下坠。
“灵溪！别睡！”
李寒山大喝一声，不敢再犹豫。
他低下头，吻住了许灵溪冰冷的唇，阳册功法全力运转，如长鲸吸水般将那股阴寒之气汲取出来。
那股极阴之气进入李寒山体内，与他自身的纯阳之气交融，阴阳交汇，竟产生了奇妙的反应。李寒山只觉得全身经脉都在震颤，修为如潮水般暴涨！
竟一举从炼气三层初期冲到了巅峰。
到了巅峰后，更是一举突破。
炼气四层！
一直冲到炼气四层巅峰，那股势头才渐渐平息下来。
content_en:
Xu Lingxi's words stunned Li Hanshan.
Take off your clothes?
Seeing Xu Lingxi's little face full of shyness and timidity, he immediately understood. Xu Lingxi thought he was going to use himself as a furnace to help her practice.
"Where did this kid go?"
Li Hanshan burst into laughter, and soon he realized another question, why did he treat Xu Lingxi as a child? His actual age is not much older than hers.
Come to think of it, this hundred-year-old body is still to blame.
He suppressed these thoughts, walked to the bed and sat down cross-legged. He pointed to the opposite side and said, "You don't need to take off your clothes. You can just sit opposite me."
"Oh."
Xu Lingxi obediently took off her cloth shoes and sat cross-legged opposite Li Hanshan.
"Reach out and relax."
Li Hanshan asked her to stretch out her hands and face her palms, and then he taught Xu Lingxi how to open her pulse step by step, just like the girl taught him in the dream.
Xu Lingxi has been practicing for more than a month. Although he has not opened his pulse, he has gained some practice experience, which makes it much easier for him to teach.
"Grandpa Li, you really know a lot."
Xu Lingxi closed her eyes, feeling the warmth flowing in her body, and a look of surprise appeared on her pretty face.
Li Hanshan didn't know anything about cultivation, he was just copying the gourd and drawing the scoop. He taught Xu Lingxi how the girl had taught him. As for whether it would be possible, he didn't know yet.
Time passed little by little.
The candlelight in the room pulsed three times, and the sky outside the window turned from pitch black to fish belly white. Fine beads of sweat appeared on Xu Lingxi's forehead, her face turned red, and her body trembled slightly.
"Still not working..."
Xu Lingxi opened her eyes, her eyes were red, and her voice was crying: "Grandpa Li, am I too stupid?"
"Don't worry, try again."
Li Hanshan comforted him warmly, but he felt a little worried in his heart. Time was running out.
In the next few days, Li Hanshan taught Xu Lingxi how to open his pulse every day.
But no matter what I tried, I made no progress.
On the fifth night, Xu Lingxi finally collapsed.
She retracted her hands, tears falling down like broken beads, and she cried until she was out of breath: "Grandpa Li, I really can't do it... I'm so useless... I don't want to be a furnace... But I really can't do it..."
"Don't cry."
Li Hanshan's heart softened and he stretched out his hand to rub her head: "I'll try another method."
He pondered for a moment and decided to take the risk.
He probed his spiritual power into Xu Lingxi's body and felt it carefully along her meridians. The girl taught him that spiritual perception is a basic skill. As long as you are careful enough, you will not hurt the other party.
The spiritual power traveled around Xu Lingxi's body, and Li Hanshan finally discovered the problem.
Xu Lingxi's meridians are not blocked, but there is an extremely hidden meridian that is naturally closed. This meridian is so deeply hidden that it cannot be discovered by ordinary methods, let alone opened.
"That's it."
Li Hanshan suddenly realized.
No wonder Xu Lingxi couldn't open her veins after practicing for more than a month. The problem was not her aptitude at all, but that this hidden vein was causing trouble.
"Lingxi, I found the problem."
Li Hanshan opened his eyes and said, "There is a closed hidden vein in your body. As long as it is opened, the pulse can be opened successfully."
Xu Lingxi raised her tearful eyes, doubtful: "Is it true?"
"Trust me."
Li Hanshan took a deep breath and mobilized his spiritual power to move towards the hidden pulse. He wants to use his spiritual power to push it away.
"Buzz!"
The spiritual power hits the closed meridians, making a buzzing sound. Xu Lingxi groaned, her face turned pale, and she bit her lip.
"Hold it!"
Li Hanshan did not stop and struck three times in succession.
However, every impact seemed to tear Xu Lingxi's meridians. She was shaking all over in pain, tears could not stop flowing, but she remained silent.
"Bo!"
With a soft sound,The closed hidden vein suddenly penetrated!
While this hidden vein was being washed away, Li Hanshan seized the opportunity and worked hard to help Xu Lingxi open the spiritual pulse in one fell swoop!
Xu Lingxi felt as if something exploded inside her body, and an unprecedented force surged out of her dantian and rushed along the meridians that had just been opened.
"It's open...it's really open..."
She opened her eyes happily, her vision blurred by tears.
However, before she could be happy for too long, a sudden change occurred!
An extremely terrifying cold air suddenly surged out of her body, gushing out like a flood from a dam!
The cold air was so intense that it even affected the room. The candles were blown out, a thin layer of frost formed on the window lattice, and even the air seemed to freeze.
"This is..."
Li Hanshan's pupils suddenly shrank.
This cold and yin energy resonated strongly with the pure yang energy in his body! His blood was boiling, his heart was beating wildly, and every pore was greedily absorbing this breath.
So tempting.
Just like a beggar who had been hungry for three days and suddenly saw a full banquet, Li Hanshan's reason was shouting crazily: Suck it! If you suck it, your cultivation will skyrocket!
His hand unconsciously reached out to Xu Lingxi.
Xu Lingxi was frightened by this sudden change and stared at Li Hanshan blankly, not understanding what happened.
"No!"
Li Hanshan bit the tip of his tongue, and the severe pain restored his clarity.
He clenched his fists tightly, his nails digging into his flesh, and used all his willpower to suppress the impulse.
Xu Lingxi trusted him, respected him, and treated him as an elder, not to mention that she had helped him before. If he takes advantage of others' danger, what's the difference between him and those witches from the Hehuan Sect?
"Huh..."
Li Hanshan closed his eyes and forced himself not to look at Xu Lingxi and not feel the temptation of the cold air.
But at this time, Xu Lingxi's body began to tremble violently.
At first it was just a slight tremor in the fingers, but soon it spread throughout the body. Her lips turned blue at a speed visible to the naked eye, and a layer of white frost formed on her eyebrows and hair. Her whole figure seemed to have been thrown into an ice cellar.
"Grandpa Li...I'm so cold..."
Xu Lingxi's teeth were chattering, her voice was broken, and her face was as pale as paper. She curled up and clasped her hands on her chest, but she couldn't stop the chill seeping from her bones.
Li Hanshan didn't care much and took her into his arms.
"It's okay, Grandpa Li is here."
He hugged Xu Lingxi tightly and tried to warm her with his own body temperature. But the cold air was so overbearing that even his body began to frost, unable to warm her at all.
Xu Lingxi's body became colder and colder, her breathing became weaker and weaker, and her eyes began to wander.
Li Hanshan's heart tightened, knowing that if this continued, Xu Lingxi might freeze to death.
"Lingxi, listen to me."
He held Xu Lingxi's face and said in a deep voice: "There is too much cold and cold air in your body, and you must suck some of it out. My pure Yang body can restrain it, but..."
He paused: "But I might have to kiss you."
Xu Lingxi heard these words in a daze, and her lips, which were purple from the cold, moved with difficulty: "Grandpa Li, suck it..."
"It's not sucking, it's kissing...you have to use your mouth."
Li Hanshan explained.
Besides using the mouth, there is another way, but that would break Xu Lingxi's body.
Xu Lingxi's consciousness was blurred. All she knew was that it was cold, so cold that she was about to die. Hearing his words, she nodded almost instinctively: "Grandpa Li, feel free to kiss me...I don't blame you..."
By the end of her speech, her voice was barely audible, and her eyelids dropped heavy.
"Lingxi! Don't sleep!"
Li Hanshan shouted loudly and did not dare to hesitate any longer.
He lowered his head and kissed Xu LingxiWith the cold lips, the Yang book technique was operating at full strength, sucking out the cold air like a whale sucking water.
That extremely yin energy entered Li Hanshan's body and blended with his own pure yang energy. The intersection of yin and yang produced a wonderful reaction. Li Hanshan only felt that the meridians throughout his body were trembling, and his cultivation level surged like a tide!
He actually rushed from the early stage of the third level of Qi refining to the peak in one fell swoop.
After reaching the peak, he made a breakthrough in one fell swoop.
Fourth level of Qi refining!
After reaching the peak of the fourth level of Qi Refining, the momentum gradually subsided.
